release_notes:
LockStepPDF 4.0.15

This hot-fix replaces the installed program file. The zip contains LockStepPDF.exe. The updater copies that program onto the file name already installed, including ReadySetPDF.exe, plus the matching _internal folder.

LibreOffice comes inside this hot-fix, in a libreoffice folder next to the program. Adding a Word, PowerPoint, or Excel file (.doc, .docx, .ppt, .pptx, .xls, .xlsx) converts it to PDF. A separate LibreOffice install is not required. Excel asks whether to use each sheet's page setup or fit all columns on one page, and which sheets to include.

A multipage TIFF comes in as one page per frame.

A document dropped into another document nests there, including nest within nest, and the original stays in the list. Recycle pulls the whole nest into the outer file and numbers the pages from the top. Add file below on the asset-list right-click places the files you pick at that spot. Insert blank still adds the page and does not open Booklet. Thumbnail scrolling in the Real-Time monitor keeps the pages already on screen.
